svg.text: What the block sheets only name, drawn: map-time tricks, the banked register files, age bits, the side divider, clock and power gating, domain crossings, and the two retire-side guards.
ldr x3 depends on wrong path: redo
in order only at retire; the architectural copy is written there
first int op after a long non-int stretch: 1+ clk late
SIMD to int: own path, 6 clk
the delay recurs after every idle stretch
test: load after a non-returning HVC leaves a footprint only if speculating
test: first SIMD op after an int stretch: fixed delay
first SIMD op: fixed extra delay
